Class OfferTurnCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.board.OfferTurnCard
public class OfferTurnCard extends Object
Represents the Offer Turn Card on the game board.

This card defines the turn order for placing totem on the offer track. For the very-first turn, it randoms the order. Each slot, depending on the number of players, assigns food rewards or food penalties. If a player cannot pay the corresponding amount of food, they lose the prestige points as a penalty.

  • Constructor Details

    • OfferTurnCard

      public OfferTurnCard(int numPlayers, List<Integer> foodRewards, int ppPenalty)
      Creates a new OfferTurnCard to keep track of the current Place Totem order. Initializes the default food rewards configuration depending on the slot position.
      Parameters:
      numPlayers - number of players for the current game
      foodRewards - food given/subtracted by each slot (must contain exactly 3 positive numbers)
      ppPenalty - prestige points penalty applied when a player cannot pay food (must be a positive number)

    • returnTotem

      public void returnTotem(Player player)
      Replaces the totem when a player completes their Offer Phase:
      • The first player or the first two players get food (or 0), depending on the number of players.
      • The last player loses food and gets a penalty if they haven't enough food.
      Parameters:
      player - the player corresponding to the totem to be returned

    • fromSnapshot

      public static OfferTurnCard fromSnapshot(OfferTurnCardSnapshot snapshot, List<Player> players)
      Recreates the OfferTurnCard with its food rewards, point penalty and the previous turn order, from a network snapshot and the base game data.
      Parameters:
      snapshot - the serialized state containing the saved totem positions, food rewards and point penalty
      players - the list of active Player instances to map the saved nicknames to actual objects
      Returns:
      the restored OfferTurnCard
